A trait adds behaviour to a component. Its optional posture decides what happens when nothing on the platform handles it. Generated from `opmodel.dev/catalogs/opm@v4` version `4.5.1`.

No transformer in this catalog handles these traits, so they are marked **Not implemented**: [EncryptionConfig](/docs/reference/catalog-members/traits/encryption/), [Sizing](/docs/reference/catalog-members/traits/sizing/).

These traits are provider-fulfilled, so they are marked **Provided by your platform**: [Backup](/docs/reference/catalog-members/traits/backup/), [BackupCommand](/docs/reference/catalog-members/traits/backup-command/). Your platform needs exactly one catalog that implements each.
